symbolic_audit.polynomial_separation_argument: A polynomial jet column has polynomial coefficients in u0. For k>0 each NP column has nonpolynomial f'(u0) multiplying its unique highest jet u_k; for k=0 its value f(u0) is nonpolynomial. Coordinate powers cannot change this, since NP columns have no x or t dependence. Rational coefficients have uncancelled complex poles; nonzero-frequency trig and nonzero-scale exp are nonpolynomial.
symbolic_audit.scope: No pairwise proportional columns; this is not full linear independence or numerical identifiability.

evaluation_before_truth.partial_path_policy: No primary model or ranking when any requested lambda is unfinished/uncertified.

limitations: Pairwise nonproportionality does not establish full linear independence or usable conditioning.
Only the declared 54 recipes are covered; no arbitrary nonpolynomial compositions are accepted.
All-real mathematical domain does not guarantee float64 representability; matrix builder rejects overflow.
Canonical coefficient errors compare recipe coordinates, not a basis-independent physical prediction metric.
A future complexity sensitivity study must be declared separately, without adjusting costs to true support.
This is a candidate-family extension, not a new L1 statistical method.
